findings.issue: Al Madhkur were themselves the rulers of Bushehr (Shaikh Nasr Al Madhkur), governing Bahrain from Bushehr as vassals of Zand Persia; they were not subordinate to 'the rulers of Bushehr'.
findings.old: يحكمها آل مذكور تابعين لحكام بوشهر في فارس
findings.fix: يحكمها آل مذكور حكام بوشهر، تابعين للدولة الزندية في فارس
findings.evidence: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bani_Utbah_invasion_of_Bahrain (Bahrain held by Nasr Al-Madhkur, ruler of Bushehr, on behalf of the Zand dynasty)

findings.issue: The 1899 bond itself contains only Mubarak's undertakings (no foreign agents, no cession/lease of territory without British consent); Britain's counterpart was a separate assurance of 'good offices' plus a payment of Rs 15,000, not a formal protection clause. Stating 'protection' as the treaty term is imprecise.
findings.fix: مقابل تعهد بريطاني منفصل بمساندته ومساندة خلفائه («المساعي الحميدة») ومبلغ من المال.
findings.evidence: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anglo-Kuwaiti_Agreement_of_1899 (text of the bond; British assurance of good offices given in accompanying letter by Col. Meade)

findings.issue: Same imprecision: the agreement text does not 'guarantee protection'; Britain promised its good offices in a separate letter.

findings.issue: 'تنحى' implies a voluntary abdication; in fact senior members of the royal family, backed by a fatwa of the ulama and the Council of Ministers, transferred the throne to Faisal on 2 Nov 1964 (27 Jumada II 1384). Wording should be factual and respectful.
findings.old: تنحى عن الملك لأخيه فيصل سنة 1964 م،
findings.fix: انتقل الملك إلى أخيه فيصل سنة 1964 م (1384 هـ) بقرار من كبار الأسرة المالكة وفتوى العلماء،

findings.issue: Prince Saud's column operated from the Najran area into the northern Yemeni highlands toward Sa'dah and was slowed by the mountains; Najran was its base/disputed area, not the objective of the advance.
findings.old: تقدم جيش بقيادة الأمير سعود في الجبال الشمالية نحو نجران،
findings.fix: تقدم جيش بقيادة الأمير سعود من جهة نجران في الجبال الشمالية نحو صعدة، فأبطأته وعورتها،

findings.issue: The 1933 concession paid a gold loan/advance (£30,000 + £5,000 annual rental) and a royalty of 4 gold shillings per ton; it did not give the state a share of production.
findings.old: مقابل مبالغ من الذهب وحصة من الإنتاج.
findings.fix: مقابل قرض ومبالغ سنوية من الذهب، وإتاوة عن كل طن من النفط المنتج.

findings.issue: Birth year is disputed: Saudipedia gives 1210 AH/1795, while Dorar and the Arabic Wikipedia lead give 1194 AH/c.1780. Death (Jumada II 1290 AH/1873) is well attested, so calling both dates approximate is imprecise; the dispute should be stated.
findings.fix: 'certainty': 'موثق؛ سنة مولده موضع خلاف (1194 أو 1210 هـ)'
findings.evidence: https://saudipedia.com/عثمان-بن-بشر (1210هـ/1795م – 1290هـ/1873م); https://dorar.net/history/event/4686 («ولد ابن بشر في جلاجل سنة 1194هـ»)

findings.issue: Attributing the founding of al-Zubarah to the Al Khalifa is contested (Qatari historiography and the Qatar–Bahrain ICJ case); UNESCO describes the town's flourishing without crediting a founder. Neutral wording: the Utub/Al Khalifa settled there c.1760s and it grew.

findings.evidence: https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/1402 ; ICJ, Maritime Delimitation and Territorial Questions between Qatar and Bahrain (2001)

findings.issue: Anachronism: in 1969 the body was the Organisation of the Islamic Conference; renamed Organisation of Islamic Cooperation in 2011. Also 'خطط ... الأولى' should be singular (first five-year plan, 1970).
findings.old: وأُعدت خطط التنمية الخمسية الأولى، وأسهم في قيام منظمة التعاون الإسلامي سنة 1969 م.
findings.fix: وأُعدت خطة التنمية الخمسية الأولى، وأسهم في قيام منظمة المؤتمر الإسلامي (منظمة التعاون الإسلامي اليوم) سنة 1969 م.
